agency: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)
service_delivery: 5 days (official service-page indicative duration; may vary)

steps.en: Open the official ICP Smart Services portal (or ICP app) and select the relevant service.
steps.ar: افتح بوابة الخدمات الذكية الرسمية للهيئة أو تطبيق ICP واختر الخدمة المناسبة.

steps.en: Review the retrieved application details and correct any errors.
steps.ar: راجع بيانات الطلب واستكمل أي تصحيحات مطلوبة.

steps.en: Supply the category-specific supporting documents if the government integration does not retrieve them.
steps.ar: زوّد المستندات الداعمة الخاصة بفئتك إذا لم يسترجعها الربط الحكومي.

steps.en: Pay the amount shown on the official payment screen after verifying the fee category.
steps.ar: ادفع المبلغ الظاهر على شاشة الدفع الحكومية بعد التحقق من فئة الرسوم.

steps.en: Complete fingerprints and signature at an ICP centre if required, especially for applicants aged 15 or over.
steps.ar: أكمل البصمة والتوقيع في مركز الهيئة إذا طُلب ذلك، لا سيما لمن أتم 15 سنة.

steps.en: Track delivery; standard cards are delivered by approved courier and urgent cards collected from the ICP centre.
steps.ar: تابع استلام البطاقة؛ التوصيل العادي عبر الناقل المعتمد والعاجل من مركز الهيئة.

description_en: Renew an expired or near-expiry Emirates ID.
description_ar: تجديد بطاقة الهوية المنتهية أو التي اقتربت من الانتهاء.

citizen: Recent personal photo different from existing Emirates ID photo
resident: Recent personal photo different from existing ID photo
Residence-related documents may be needed through a linked application depending on status and emirate
gcc: GCC ID and category-specific proof of qualifying status may be required

fees.resident: AED 100 per year of residence + AED 100 smart application fee as listed
fees.gcc: AED 100 for five-year ID + AED 100 smart application fee as listed
fees.urgent: AED 150 additional at an authority service centre where eligible

caveats: For residents, the identity renewal is linked to residency application in all emirates except Dubai, according to ICP service guidance. Confirm the current Dubai route with the competent authority.
A passport valid for at least 3 months is stated among renewal conditions.
Document and fee requirements differ by applicant category; do not assume all items apply to all applicants.

name_en: Replace lost or damaged Emirates ID
name_ar: إصدار بدل فاقد أو تالف للهوية الإماراتية
description_en: Replace a lost or damaged card; new card retains original validity.
description_ar: طلب بطاقة بدل فاقد أو تالف بنفس مدة صلاحية البطاقة الأصلية.

resident: Proof of UAE residence may be required

fees.smart: AED 100 smart service fee as listed
fees.urgent: AED 150 additional for eligible urgent service at ICP centre
fees.data_update: AED 150 for replacement data update at an ICP centre, if applicable

caveats: The replacement is issued for the remaining validity of the original card.
For a card that has also expired, check whether replacement or renewal is appropriate; do not assume an outcome.

description_en: Apply for the first Emirates ID card.
description_ar: طلب إصدار بطاقة هوية إماراتية لأول مرة.

resident: Proof of residence and any residence-permit-linked documents according to status
gcc: Valid GCC ID and additional proof based on qualifying category

fees.resident: AED 100 per year of residence + AED 100 smart service fee as listed
fees.gcc: AED 100 five-year ID + AED 100 smart service fee as listed
fees.urgent: AED 150 additional at ICP centres where available

caveats: For certain residence permit cases, the sponsor may need to submit the linked application.
A medical fitness result or additional approval may be required for applicable residence cases.
First-time applicants aged 15 and above need fingerprint and signature procedures.
